# netactuate_dedicated_server_power_status (Resource)

Reads dedicated server power status through the API status action. Deleting this resource removes it from Terraform state only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_dedicated_server_power_status" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Dedicated server package ID.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Force flag sent to the status action only when configured.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password sent to the status action only when configured.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status_json` (String) Compact JSON power status payload returned by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_dedicated_server_power_status.example 12345
```
